decision: budget for today is about 1.4 GPU node-hours, so every script is checked on CPU first and GPU work goes in at most two allocations

decision: gave every mode settings as name:key=value and added capacity_factor, degree and 2DH for Tutel, a DeepSpeed MOELayer mode, and num_sms, chunk sizes and a fused reduce for DeepEP

decision: a mode that drops copies is checked against plain run on the copies it keeps
why: Tutel's default capacity drops copies, so comparing it with full plain would always fail
result: login-GPU smoke run passed for tutel:capacity_factor=1 and ds_moe:capacity_factor=2

decision: packed every GPU step into one 2-node allocation with per-step time limits; record routing on node 2 while node 1 runs one-node steps
why: node-hour budget; a failed step must not waste the allocation

decision: first allocation finished every step in 7.5 minutes (0.25 node-hours); only the DeepEP two-node attempt failed, as it was meant to

decision: found my DeepEP adapter was most of its time: index_add_ reduce 3.6 ms against 1.8 ms in DeepEP's own kernels
why: trace of the default DeepEP mode on rank 0
result: fused reduce 5.96 -> 2.82 ms, plus 48 SMs -> 2.18 ms (plain 5.77)

decision: traces of the first job were misaligned between ranks (a transfer kernel waited 16 ms for peers), so added a barrier inside the profiler and cut the timeline at the first phase
why: the first trace picture would have shown waiting as transfer time

decision: added tutel half=True and ds_moe dense=True for the second job
why: Tutel has no bf16 kernel and converts to float32, and the DeepSpeed that Tutel was published against used dense einsums
evidence: benchmark/all2all/baselines.py; CPU check passes for dense; login-GPU run passes for half
result: half must not share a process with other Tutel dtypes: Tutel caches kernels by device only (nan otherwise)

decision: intra-node loads were 80 GB/s in a one-node communicator and 23 GB/s in the two-node one, so added a source that uses the node's own communicator
why: a side running far below its measured bound is untuned, and RBD already has a node group
